beats.text: On September 30th, Trump stood before hundreds of real generals and admirals at Quantico and immediately started bragging about the military -- to the people who actually run it.

beats.caption: You never heard Biden say that.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: Wrong. PolitiFact found Biden bragging about the strongest military on record more than a dozen times. Undeterred, Trump moved on to bigger secrets.

beats.caption: I moved a submarine or two.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: Then, still riffing on nuclear weapons, he revealed his own private code word for the subject.
Turns out there's a second one, too.

beats.caption: There are two N-words, and you can't use either of them.
beats.label: via LiveNOW from FOX

beats.text: Four hundred officers. Dead silence. Somewhere in that room, a very confused stenographer just kept typing.
